HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 23.03.2023 CRL.M.A. 7654/2023Exemption 1.
Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of accordingly.

3. The present petition Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR No. 108/2017, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Jagat Puri, Delhi, and all other consequential proceedings emanating therefrom, including the chargesheet pending before the court of Ms. Shruti Sharma, learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi.
4.
It is pointed out that the father-in-law of the complainant/respondent no. 2 who is also an accused in the present FIR, has since passed away.
6. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file a status report.
Let the same be done before the next date of hearing.

7. List on 08.05.2023.
